rubrics.text: stool remains long in the rectum
stool remains long in the rectum with no urging
unable to pass the stool in presence of nurse
cord extending from anus to navel
and a feeling as if a plug were wedged between the pubis and coccyx
as soon as the rheumatism is amel.
when not straining; voluntary defecation impossible
as from a claw in anus
perspiration about the anus and perineum
